cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — brushes her hair with a hairbrush; a Han-era inn — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; a quiet modern textile studio with a small table loom in warm morning light — she retrieves a dropped wooden shuttle from the low shelf beneath the loom; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a small sunlit kite-repair workshop with bamboo frames and colourful paper on a workbench — she balances a newly repaired crescent-shaped paper kite on one fingertip to test its centre of gravity; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — standing; a misty enchanted garden of moss — standing; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — standing; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a Yangtze ferry landing with moored junks under red sails and coiled ropes on the wooden pier — lying on her front; a nightclub with a dance floor under moving coloured lights and a velvet-rope queue at its door — standing; a retro American diner — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds her keepsake at chest height
